description_en: Submits a video copyright watermark job
description_zh: 调用SubmitCopyrightJob提交视频版权水印任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-copyright-job --input Type=OSS Media=oss://bucket/object --biz-output Type=OSS Media=oss://test-bucket/output.mp4 --message Copyright_watermark_test --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitCopyrightJob

fields.help_en:
The input file, specified as either an OSS URL or a media asset ID. The following formats are supported for OSS URLs:

1. `oss://bucket/object`

2. `http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object`

In these formats, `bucket` specifies the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the service, and `object` specifies the file path
fields.help_zh:
输入文件信息，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为：

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values:

`OSS`: The URL of an OSS object.

`Media`: The media asset ID
fields.help_zh:
输入文件类型，取值：
OSS：OSS文件地址
Media：媒资ID
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The input video file to be watermarked.

The OSS object or media asset must be in the same region as the service call
parameters.help_zh:
待添加水印的视频文件。

OSS文件/媒资的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

fields.help_en:
The OSS URL for the output file. The following formats are supported: 1. `oss://bucket/object` 2. `http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object`
In these formats, `bucket` specifies the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the service, and `object` specifies the file path.
fields.help_zh:
输出文件信息，支持 OSS 地址。 OSS 地址规则为：

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中 bucket 为和当前项目处于同一区域的 oss bucket 名称，object 为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the output file. Valid value:

`OSS`: The URL of an OSS object
fields.help_zh:
输出文件类型，取值：

OSS：OSS文件地址
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The location of the output file.

The OSS bucket must be in the same region as the service call
parameters.help_zh:
输出文件地址。

OSS的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The start time of the watermark in seconds. Defaults to 0
parameters.help_zh: 水印起始时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为0
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the watermark in seconds. If unspecified, the watermark is applied until the video ends
parameters.help_zh: 水印结束时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为视频时长
parameters.name: total_time

parameters.help_en: The watermark level, which specifies the embedding channel. Valid values are 0, 1, and 2, which correspond to the U, UV, and YUV channels, respectively
parameters.help_zh: 水印级别，取值0/1/2，表示嵌入通道，0u，1uv，2yuv
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: A description of the watermark job
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The user data. The value can be up to 1,024 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The parameters for the watermark job, specified as a JSON string. The following parameter is supported:

`algoType`: The algorithm type. Defaults to `v1`.

`v1`: For videos 3 minutes or longer.

`v2`: For short videos
parameters.help_zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。
v1：长视频版权水印，仅支持3min以上的。
v2：短视频版权水印
parameters.name: params
